intent: A tall tarnished-bronze crown-helm of uneven bone tines and a dark face mask over warm bronze-brown mail with green verdigris, a broad bronze collar holding a pale bone gorget and a mouldering moss cloak hung from one shoulder, so the high camera reads a pale crown over a bronze yoke and a green back.
requests: A tapered crown point: boxes read as pegs at the high camera, where a wedge or cone point would sharpen the crown.
A bronze that reads as metal under the flat night preset: Metal renders tan and carries no shine, so the whole bronze look has to live in the colour.
A soft draped mantle: the cloak cannot fall over one shoulder in one cloth piece, so it is built from boxes.
